summary: Viking Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on September 10, 2026 its board authorized a share repurchase program of up to $1 billion of outstanding ordinary shares, with the press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1. No per-share price, premium or expiration date was stated, and no advisor was named. Repurchases may occur via open-market purchases, privately negotiated transactions, accelerated share repurchase transactions or other means, potentially under Rule 10b-18 or 10b5-1 plans. The program is discretionary, uncommitted to any specific amount, and may be modified, suspended or terminated at any time; no regulatory clock or ownership split is implicated. Watch execution pace, buyback-driven EPS accretion and any concurrent insider selling against capital-allocation signals.
